test_reload_env: test the reload_env function that re-reads .env files into os.environ
test_redact_key: test the redact_key function that masks long API keys with prefix, suffix and ellipsis
test_web_server_status_endpoint: test the FastAPI /api/status endpoint returning version, hermes_home, and active_sessions
test_web_server_config_schema: test the /api/config/schema endpoint returning field definitions with types and categories
test_web_server_config_round_trip: test GET and PUT /api/config endpoints preserving model subkeys and nested values
test_web_server_env_reveal: test the POST /api/env/reveal endpoint returning unredacted env var values with auth
test_web_server_session_token_removed: test that the /api/auth/session-token endpoint no longer returns a JSON token
test_build_schema_from_config: test _build_schema_from_config producing schema entries with type, category, and merged categories
test_model_context_length_normalize: test _normalize_config_for_web extracting context_length from model dict configs
test_model_context_length_denormalize: test _denormalize_config_from_web writing context_length back into model dict on save
test_model_info_endpoint: test the GET /api/model/info endpoint returning model, provider, capabilities, and context lengths
test_probe_gateway_health: test _probe_gateway_health probing remote gateway with /health/detailed and /health fallback
test_status_remote_gateway_fallback: test /api/status falling back to remote gateway health probe when local PID check fails
test_web_server_unauthenticated_access: test that unauthenticated API requests are rejected with 401 except public endpoints
test_web_server_path_traversal_blocked: test that URL-encoded path traversal attempts return SPA HTML instead of system files
